top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock rests on a simple, general mechanism: at the magic wavelength the light shifts of the two clock levels cancel, so many neutral atoms are interrogated at once free of Doppler and recoil shifts. This is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-quantum-system prizes. It is understood term by term and verified by direct comparisons between independent laboratories at the 10^-18 level, and the credit to Katori and Ye is a clean pair within the three-name limit. The scheme, not the number, should carry the citation. The remaining reservations (metrology as increment, omitted contributors) do not outweigh awarding it over no award.
